name: MenubarSkeleton
description: A placeholder bar with the same height and rhythm as the loaded bar.
signature: ({ labels, count, size, className }: MenubarSkeletonProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: count
props.description: How many menus to stand in for when the labels are not known. Default 5.

props.name: labels
props.description: The menus' labels, when they are known: each placeholder then takes that trigger's exact width.

props.name: size
props.description: The size the bar will take.
